name.en: Payment initiation with maker, checker and authoriser
name.hi: निर्माता, जाँचकर्ता एवं प्राधिकारी सहित भुगतान प्रारंभ

description: Corporate / treasury payment (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, SWIFT): beneficiary name validation, sanctions screening, rail limits by rule (RTGS minimum, IMPS cap), checker and a second authoriser above the band with SoD by person and seat and approval bound to the payload hash; the transfer is class (c): lost response goes to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and reconciliation with the statement; returns credited back.

acceptance.title: Above-band payment needs two different approvers
acceptance.then: an authoriser task opens; the checker cannot take it
